summary: Internal IT/admin users receiving 403 in Console (missing permissions) during RBAC v2 dogfood
description:
Issue summary:
Internal IT/admin users (Okta group: "IT-Admins" and "Corp-Helpdesk") are getting blocked in the Redwood Console during RBAC v2 dogfood with "You don’t have permission" / 403 errors. They cannot access org settings pages needed for provisioning and support.

Impact:
- IT cannot perform basic admin workflows (user provisioning checks, role assignments, org-level settings) during dogfood.
- Support/IT escalations increasing because admins cannot self-serve.
- Risk: perceived instability of RBAC v2 rollout; potential to slow down internal dogfood readiness.

Environment:
- Console: prod (internal dogfood)
- Authz: RBAC v2 feature flag enabled for Redwood internal org
- Identity: Okta SSO with group->role mapping

Who is impacted:
- David Kim (IT)
- Fiona McCarthy (SecOps)
- On-call internal admins attempting to triage permission-denied reports

Symptoms / error:
- Console shows toast/banner: "Permission denied" and fails to load Org Settings -> Users/Roles
- Network calls fail with HTTP 403
- Denial debug header (for admin requests) indicates missing permission for console endpoints

Steps to reproduce:
1) Login to Console with Okta user in "IT-Admins" group
2) Select Redwood internal dogfood org
3) Navigate to Settings -> Users
4) Observe 403 from console backend

Expected:
IT-Admins should have at least read/write access for org user/role management and ability to view audit logs for support purposes.

Actual:
Existing group mapping grants a legacy v1 role which does not map cleanly in v2. Under deny-by-default enforcement, Console endpoints now require explicit permissions and the IT-Admins role binding does not include the Console permission set.

Notes:
- This appears after enabling RBAC v2 dogfood flag and after adopting deny-by-default middleware for Console backend routes.
- Similar denial pattern reported in #help, but this ticket focuses on internal admin access for IT/SecOps.
comments: 2025-01-28 09:12 PT - David Kim (Reporter): Noticed since yesterday afternoon: IT-Admins can log in but cannot open Settings -> Users / Roles. Console shows permission denied and page is blank. This blocks provisioning troubleshooting for new hires. Please advise on correct role binding under RBAC v2 dogfood.

2025-01-28 09:34 PT - Kaitlyn Nguyen (Assignee): Acknowledged. Please paste a request ID from the failed call (from DevTools) and confirm which Okta groups the user is in. Also confirm whether you’re in the Redwood internal org or a test org.
2025-01-28 10:02 PT - David Kim: Request ID: req_7d3b1c1f1a. User in Okta groups: IT-Admins, Corp-Helpdesk. Org: Redwood Internal (dogfood).

2025-01-28 10:25 PT - Felix Schneider (Console): Pulled logs for req_7d3b1c1f1a. Denied on action permission: "console.org.users.list" (exact string in log) at scope org=redwood-internal. Denial reason code in log: MISSING_PERMISSION. User had bindings only for legacy role "admin" (v1) which in v2 mapping does not include Console permissions (only a subset for API key mgmt).

2025-01-28 10:41 PT - Kaitlyn Nguyen: Confirmed: This is a migration gap in our default mapping for internal admin groups. In v2, Console backend endpoints require explicit console.* permissions; the legacy mapping grants control-plane.* but not console.*. Proposing immediate workaround: bind IT-Admins to built-in template "Org Admin" in Redwood Internal org until we finalize an "Internal Admin" template.

2025-01-28 11:05 PT - David Kim: Workaround sounds ok. We need IT to be able to manage users/roles + view audit logs. We do not want IT to have billing admin by default if avoidable, but can accept temporarily for dogfood.

2025-01-28 11:22 PT - Jordan Lee (Policy engine): +1 on short-term fix. Longer-term: add a first-party role template "IT Support Admin" (org-scoped) with users/roles read-write, audit log read/export, no billing, no secret rotation. We should generate it in the policy bundle and document recommended internal group mapping.

2025-01-28 12:10 PT - Kaitlyn Nguyen: Implemented immediate fix in Redwood Internal org: created role binding: Okta group "IT-Admins" -> role template "Org Admin" at org scope. Also added "Corp-Helpdesk" -> "Read-only Auditor" temporarily so Helpdesk can at least view user lists and audit logs. Please re-login and confirm.

2025-01-28 12:37 PT - David Kim: Confirmed after logout/login: Settings -> Users loads, can invite/remove users and edit role assignments. Audit log page loads as well. Thanks. Requesting follow-up to reduce scope (remove billing permissions) before broad dogfood.

2025-01-29 09:18 PT - Naomi Feldman (PM): Tracking follow-up action: define internal-facing role template (IT Support Admin) and update internal Okta mapping guidance. Please link any proposed permission set to the Role Templates & Matrix page.

2025-01-30 14:05 PT - Chloe Martin (Console backend): Adding note: we should ensure Console pages have clearer “why denied” UX for internal dogfood. Current experience is blank page + toast. We should at least show required permission + escalation path for admins (ties to denial reason codes + debug header).

2025-02-03 10:28 PT - Kaitlyn Nguyen: Follow-ups captured below. Closing this internal support ticket since access is restored via role binding change; remaining work will be tracked in engineering/product tickets.

Resolution:
- Added org-scoped role bindings for Okta groups IT-Admins and Corp-Helpdesk in Redwood Internal org.
- Verified IT-Admins can access Console org admin workflows.

Root cause:
- Legacy/v1 role mapping did not include newly required console.* permissions under deny-by-default middleware.

Follow-up actions:
1) Create/ship "IT Support Admin" role template (no billing) in policy bundle; update internal mapping docs (Owner: Jordan Lee / Naomi Feldman).
2) Add guardrail: internal dogfood checklist must validate IT/SecOps access before enabling flags broadly (Owner: Connor O'Brien).
3) Improve Console denied state to display required permission + link to request access (Owner: Tessa Morgan / Felix Schneider).
4) Add an automated check/test ensuring built-in admin templates include required console.* permissions for Settings pages (Owner: Leila Farouk).
resolution: Role binding fix applied in Redwood Internal org: mapped Okta groups IT-Admins -> Org Admin (org scope) and Corp-Helpdesk -> Read-only Auditor (org scope). Access verified by reporter. Follow-up work created to introduce a narrower IT Support Admin role template and improve denied-state UX.
